title: Cross-room carry Stage A-fix: unloaded west -> divider door -> zone B, with the four Stage A failure-mode fixes

policy.base: visgoal candidate C build c390105c2 (vendored byte copy), expanding search on, arrival aim inset 0

scene.scenario: s1_normal_mixed_v7 (full scene, same as Stage A)

fix_metrics.gap_claims_with_gt_crossing_n: of the above, how many actually GT-crossed
fix_metrics.gap_claim_false_n: gap claims without a GT crossing (Stage A baseline: 9/9)
fix_metrics.door_align_uncertain_ticks: ticks with only one jamb visible
fix_metrics.collision_ticks_n: ticks with any MJWarp contact (contact recorder)
fix_metrics.contact_events: rising edges with classified geom categories
fix_metrics.door_lateral_offset_m: eval-only at GT crossing (Stage A baseline: -0.1634 m)
fix_metrics.door_min_jamb_gap_m: eval-only at GT crossing (Stage A baseline: -0.1084 m)

paint_filter.basis: floor_patch record extent_m: the long_beam blue end band footprint is 0.036 x 0.041 m (diagonal 0.054 m, zone_cargo.py), while any visible zone-B patch is at least the 0.30 m short side of the authored zone; the threshold sits between the two known geometries and is not tuned from gate episodes.
paint_filter.acceptance_effect: only rejects colour bands; does not add success.

gap_twosided.constant: tracked_side_ticks_min=12 ticks (1.2 Sim s), same-side front wall range <= 1.6 m
gap_twosided.basis: Stage A: 9/9 gap claims were false (skill claimed gap, GT never crossed); real door leaves the far jamb in the same-side forward sector, an open pickup-room corner does not.
gap_twosided.measurement_note: a rejected gap keeps wall following; the change is measured, not guaranteed to fix the mission.

door_align.constant: align_tolerance_m=0.02 m, small calibrated turn pulses, never forward while misaligned
door_align.basis: Stage A crossing lateral offset -0.1634 m vs the unloaded +/-0.055 m door budget; the two jamb wall feet give an own-RGB lateral estimate.

contacts.constant: no new constant; eval-only MJWarp contact count/geom pairs
contacts.basis: Stage A collision_events was not_measured because the runner never read the contact arrays; MJWarp Data exposes contact/nacon/geom/worldid.

mission_scope: unloaded destination search only; no cargo; not pooled with Stage A/B or visgoal/egonav/ACT.
success_threshold: none (measurement gate). Compare with Stage A baseline: false gap claims, GT crossing, lateral offset/min jamb gap, false paint hints, and contact recording. Any improvement claim must be checked against the raw.
expected_wall: about 2.5-3.1 h for 16 x 180 Sim s at the gcp3 batch rate, same as Stage A.
